Understanding Intraday Trading

Market sessions, setups, discipline and risk management. This page provides an educational starting point. Market conditions, products and rules can change, so verify current information from official sources before making decisions.

Key ideas

  • Understand the purpose and structure of the product.
  • Study risks before thinking about returns.
  • Read current official disclosures.
  • Avoid rumours and guaranteed-return claims.
  • Match decisions with your goals and risk tolerance.
